critique.title: AI Critique
critique.quote: He turns design intent into clear systems, then iterates without losing what already works.
critique.attribution: ChatGPT, based on our work across product design, implementation and generative AI.
critique.modalTitle: How I work, according to AI
critique.pattern: Across Charles' product and generative work, the same method keeps appearing: define the source of truth, specify constraints, compare the result against intent, turn failures into explicit rules, and iterate without disturbing approved work.
critique.systems: The work is defined as connected behaviour, states and rules rather than isolated screens. Product logic, lifecycle and edge cases are treated as part of the design.
critique.intent: Visual truth and functional truth are separated. Figma defines presentation; requirements define behaviour, content and scope. Implementation is reviewed against both.
critique.iteration: Approved work is protected. Bugs and generation failures become reusable rules, allowing the next iteration to improve without reopening decisions that already work.
critique.ai: AI is used as an implementation and creative collaborator, not the product owner. Intent, judgement and final approval remain human-directed.
critique.bottom: The strongest pattern is not a particular tool or medium. It is the ability to translate intent into constraints, test the result against that intent, and progressively make the system more reliable.
critique.scope: Approved work is protected. Changes are deliberately surgical, with explicit instructions about what must not change.
critique.failures: Bugs and generation errors are treated as evidence of a missing or violated rule, then converted into reusable specifications.
critique.spec: The same discipline extends from UX into generative media: assign references, preserve fixed assets, define motion and constraints, then iterate against intent.
critique.shiftHeading: From individual outputs to reliable systems
critique.shift: The work increasingly shifts from producing individual outputs toward designing systems that reliably produce the intended outputs.
critique.fullCritique: Strong systems thinking, explicit state and edge-case definition, high sensitivity to implementation drift, and a consistent preference for preserving approved work rather than repeatedly redesigning.
